# MageLift

MageLift is an Apache-2.0 CLI for small Magento teams and agencies. It runs
Magento Open Source and licensed Adobe Commerce locally with Docker and
deploys the shop into its own cloud account. Shop settings live in magelift.php.

## Try a shop

Run `go install ./cmd/magelift` in the MageLift checkout. Then open the
Magento checkout and run `magelift init --provider aws` and `magelift dev`.
Pick `gcp` or `azure` for the other clouds. Open the local shop URL printed
by the CLI.
https://magelift.dev/docs/getting-started/

## Cloud accounts

AWS ECS Fargate and Google Cloud GKE Autopilot have recorded Magento runs.
Azure AKS has Pulumi mock and Floci API tests and is experimental. AWS EKS
and Google Cloud GKE Standard are also experimental. The provider guide
lists what the tests exercised. https://magelift.dev/docs/capability-matrix/

Cloud deployment uses a verified provider plugin. Connect your account,
build an application image in your registry, and deploy the image by digest.
Your cloud provider bills for running resources. https://magelift.dev/docs/bootstrap/
https://magelift.dev/docs/builds/ · https://magelift.dev/pricing.md

## Move and operate a shop

Import settings using `magelift init --from-acc`, `--from-upsun`, or
`--from-compose`. Rehearse the database and media transfer before switching
traffic. https://magelift.dev/docs/migrating-from-paas/

Deploy staging and production from the same image digest. Use the CLI for
logs, health, and environment settings. A generated GitHub Actions workflow
can create and remove pull-request previews. https://magelift.dev/docs/operations/
